plain_text:
The Michigan Radio Network label in this archive points to the early Michigan regional chain built around WXYZ and neighboring stations, a network closely tied to The Lone Ranger and to the station relationships that helped lead toward Mutual.

In Golden Radio Hour, Michigan Radio Network is tied to 1 program. The surviving network-linked recordings here run from 1943 to 1947.

Programs with a particularly strong presence here include Challenge of the Yukon.

People who recur often in those network-linked recordings include Jay Michael, Mildred Merrill, Betty Joyce, Hal Neal, Hugh Holder, Fran Striker, Larry McCann, Jack McCarthy, Bill Morgan, and Bob Hite. These are archive connections, not a claim that everyone on the list was employed directly by the network.
